We are seeking a Sustaining Mechanical Engineer to support, maintain, and optimize complex test infrastructure used to validate advanced energy systems.

* Monitor system performance and identify opportunities to improve reliability, stability, and uptime.
* Support validation efforts by ensuring test equipment accurately represents intended operating conditions.
* Update and maintain CAD models, BOMs, work instructions, and other technical documentation.
* Document troubleshooting activities, root cause findings, and corrective actions.
